name: renameat2
synopsis: int renameat2(int olddirfd, const char *oldpath, int newdirfd, const char *newpath, unsigned int flags);
description: renameat2() renames a file or directory, similar to renameat(), but allows additional flags to control the operation, such as exchanging files or creating whiteouts. It operates atomically and supports features like RENAME_NOREPLACE to avoid overwriting existing files.

parameters.name: olddirfd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the directory containing oldpath, or AT_FDCWD for current working directory

parameters.name: oldpath
parameters.description: Path to the file or directory to rename

parameters.name: newdirfd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the directory containing newpath, or AT_FDCWD for current working directory

parameters.name: newpath
parameters.description: New path for the file or directory

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify the rename behavior, such as RENAME_NOREPLACE, RENAME_EXCHANGE, or RENAME_WHITEOUT

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Write permission is denied for the directory containing oldpath or newpath
